# Phase pipeline contract (Part IX §9.1)

The weekly cycle is data, not code. Each phase owns its transient write-contract; persistent `state.*` keys list their authorized writer phases. This page mirrors `scsim/pipeline_schema.json` — the snapshot test fails the build on accidental drift (Tier-3 changes re-freeze it with an ADR).

| Phase | Name | Owns (transient) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| PH-00 | week_start | disruption_state | Onset/recovery profiles → physical disruption state for the week. |
| PH-10 | demand_realization | demand, forecast | Update the demand forecast from history (§3.3 models), then draw D_p[t] from the world demand stream. |
| PH-20 | detection | firm_knowledge | Firm-visible events (t ≥ start + detection_lag). P-S.4 / P-X.1 evaluate here. |
| PH-30 | fulfill_from_stock | fg_fulfillment | MTS serves D_p from I^FG; no-op for MTO products. |
| PH-40 | production_planning | production_plan, overtime_capacity, substitutions | Plan production: default greedy plan; P-P.5/P-P.9 et al. adjust here. |
| PH-50 | production_execute | production_output | Pure mechanics (Eqs. 8/9): produce Q_p, consume materials. |
| PH-60 | fulfillment | fulfillment | F_p, B_p, L_p — P-C.1/P-C.2/P-C.3 resident. |
| PH-70 | material_planning | material_demand, inventory_levels | D_m projection (Eq. 1); s_m/S_m levels (Eqs. 2–3) + safety stock. |
| PH-80 | procurement | purchase_orders | Order release (Eqs. 4–6) and sourcing decisions; orders enter the supplier queue. |
| PH-90 | logistics | arrivals | Ship queue under capacity gating, defer in-window arrivals (Eqs. 11–12), expedite (Eqs. 18–19), land arrivals. |
| PH-99 | accounting | kpi_rows | Read-only KPI rows, cost rollup, trace. |

## Persistent state writers

| Key | Writable from |
|---|---|
| `state.on_hand` | PH-50, PH-90 |
| `state.backlog` | PH-60 |
| `state.lost_sales` | PH-60 |
| `state.pipeline` | PH-80, PH-90 |
| `state.queue` | PH-80, PH-90 |
| `state.fg_on_hand` | PH-30, PH-50 |
| `state.fg_target` | PH-70 |
| `state.cost_ledger` | PH-00, PH-10, PH-20, PH-30, PH-40, PH-50, PH-60, PH-70, PH-80, PH-90, PH-99 |
